usage: deskops review preflight [-h] [--root ROOT] [--engine ENGINE]
                                [--max-attempts MAX_ATTEMPTS] [--force]
                                [--reason REASON] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                                [--run RUN] [--format {text,json,yaml}]
                                task

Review a task from its TaskDoc alone (before dispatch).

positional arguments:
  task                  Task selector.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --engine ENGINE       RuntimeProfileDoc id under desk/runtimes (default
                        runtime-pi-deepseek-flash).
  --max-attempts MAX_ATTEMPTS
                        Maximum good attempts per key (default 2).
  --force               Re-review even when the cap is reached; requires
                        --reason.
  --reason REASON       Why this forced re-review runs; recorded in
                        manifest.json and the ReviewDoc.
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Model call timeout in seconds (default 900).
  --run RUN             Run directory name under runs/subagents/ (default a
                        timestamp).
  --format {text,json,yaml}
                        Output format.

Example:
  deskops review preflight task-fix-thing --root .
